Indikator 2 measures the proportion of newly diagnosed [[atrieflimren]] patients who receive an [[ekkokardiografi]] within a specific timeframe, serving as a critical quality metric for cardiovascular care in [[danmark]] [^src3] [^src5]. The established standard for this indicator requires that at least 80% of the incident patient population undergoes the procedure between six months before and three months after their first diagnosis date [^src3] [^src5]. The procedure is tracked using specific registry codes, including [[uxuc80]] for transthoracic echocardiography [^src5].

Across the three reported periods, national performance shows a steady upward trend, eventually crossing the 80% threshold. In 2022/23, the national average was 79.2%, narrowly missing the standard [^src1]. By 2023/24, the national proportion rose to 80.6%, successfully meeting the target [^src2]. This improvement was sustained in 2024/25, with the national average reaching 81.0% [^src4].

At the regional level, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] are the consistent leaders, meeting the ≥80% standard in all three years [^src1] [^src2] [^src4]. Region Midtjylland peaked at 88.5% in 2022/23 and 87.4% in 2024/25 [^src1] [^src4]. Conversely, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] consistently trail, failing to meet the standard in any of the three periods; Region Hovedstaden's performance hovered between 70.9% and 74.9% [^src1] [^src2] [^src4]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] demonstrated mixed results, missing the target in 2022/23 (78.7%) and 2024/25 (79.4%), but narrowly achieving it in 2023/24 (80.2%) [^src1] [^src2] [^src4].

When examining individual hospitals and health clusters (sundhedsklynger), significant geographic variation and extreme outliers emerge. In the 2022/23 hospital-level data, [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] (98.8%) and [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] (98.5%) were exceptional leaders, while [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]] was a severe outlier on the low end, achieving only 45.6% [^src1]. By the 2024/25 cluster-level reporting, [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] emerged as the national leader with 92.9%, whereas [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] recorded the lowest performance at 68.1% [^src4]. Other notable high-performing clusters in 2024/25 included [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] (88.4%) and [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] (88.2%), while [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelese|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] (72.3%) and Region Hovedstaden (74.9%) remained persistent trailers [^src4].

Comprehensive methodological frameworks, data infrastructure descriptions, and extended regional analyses supporting these findings are detailed throughout the respective annual reports [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24] [^src25] [^src26] [^src27] [^src28] [^src29] [^src30] [^src31] [^src32] [^src33] [^src34] [^src35] [^src36] [^src37] [^src38] [^src39] [^src40] [^src41] [^src42] [^src43] [^src44] [^src45] [^src46] [^src47] [^src48].
